spans.s:
The affix क्विप्‌ comes after the verb कृ 'to make' with the sense of past time, when the following words in the Accusative -2nd case are in composition - 1. सु 'action' 2. कर्म 'action' 3. पाप 'sin' 4. मन्त्र 'hymn' 5. पुण्य 'virtue'.

Terms: क्विप्‌

The affix घन् comes in the sense of 'that its deity' after the word शुक्र।

Terms: घन्
